'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Syrian civil war]]
**[[2024 Syrian opposition offensives]]
***[[Battle of Aleppo (2024)|Battle of Aleppo]]
****Anti-[[Bashar al-Assad|Assad]] forces led by [[Tahrir al-Sham]] enter the city of [[Aleppo]], [[Syria]], for the first time [[Battle of Aleppo (2012–2016)|since 2016]] with heavy [[Urban warfare|urban fighting]] reportedly underway in the western neighbourhoods of the city. A [[Syrian Salvation Government|rebel coalition]] spokesman confirms that an operation to capture Aleppo has officially begun. [https://edition.cnn.com/2024/11/29/world/syria-rebels-aleppo-war-intl/index.html (CNN)] [https://www.newarab.com/news/syria-rebels-fighting-within-aleppo-offensive-continues (''The New Arab'')]
****Rebel forces reach the city centre of Aleppo after overrunning multiple neighbourhoods, including [[New Aleppo]]. [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/armed-groups-opposed-to-assads-regime-in-syrian-enter-aleppo-city-center/3408670 (Anadolu Agency)] [https://apnews.com/article/syria-attack-clashes-aleppo-9c07da6f83036f34d4b18a479de9d085 (AP)]
****[[Syria]]n [[state media]] reports that four people are killed when rebel forces [[Shell (projectile)|shell]] the [[University of Aleppo]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/four-civilians-killed-attack-aleppos-university-city-syria-state-news-agency-2024-11-29/?taid=67497de2876e820001f7559c&utm_campaign=trueAnthem:+Trending+Content&utm_medium=trueAnthem&utm_source=twitter (Reuters)]
***Rebel forces capture the towns of [[Al-Hadher, Syria|Al-Hadher]], [[Khan Tuman]] and [[Al-Eiss]] in [[Aleppo Governorate]]. [https://www.syriahr.com/%d9%88%d8%b3%d8%b7-%d8%a7%d9%86%d9%87%d9%8a%d8%a7%d8%b1-%d9%82%d9%88%d8%a7%d8%aa-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%86%d8%b8%d8%a7%d9%85-%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%87%d9%8a%d8%a6%d8%a9-%d9%88%d8%a7%d9%84%d9%81%d8%b5%d8%a7/738280/ (SOHR)] 
***Rebel forces capture the city of [[Saraqib]] in [[Idlib Governorate]], which has been held by [[Syrian Armed Forces|government forces]] since 2020. Pro-government forces withdraw from the city after two days of clashes. [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/syria-insurgents-push-advance-2nd-largest-city-aleppo-116315961 (ABC News)] [https://www.aa.com.tr/en/middle-east/armed-groups-opposed-to-assads-regime-in-syria-enter-aleppo-city-center/3408670 (Anadolu Ajansi)]
*[[Russo-Ukrainian War]]
**[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]], [[Ukraine–NATO relations]]
***[[Peace negotiations in the Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
****[[President of Ukraine|Ukrainian president]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyy]] says that [[Ukraine|his country]] is ready to agree to a [[ceasefire]] if [[NATO]] protects parts of Ukraine. [https://www.kyivpost.com/post/43076 (''Kyiv Post'')]
*[[Sudanese civil war (2023-present)|Sudanese civil war]]
**[[Battle of Khartoum (2023-present)|Battle of Khartoum]]
***It is reported that 12 children have died this month in [[Khartoum]], [[Sudan]], due to city-wide [[malnutrition]]. [https://sudantribune.com/article293990/ (Sudan Tribune)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2024–2025 floods in Southeast Asia and South Asia]]
**At least three people are killed and more than 84,000 people are displaced by flooding in [[Malaysia]], primarily in [[Kelantan]]. [https://apnews.com/article/malaysia-floods-monsoon-rains-08532d729eb70026e968b1ee34b029c6 (AP)]
*[[2024–25 Australian region cyclone season]]
**The death toll from the [[flood]]s and [[landslide]]s in [[North Sumatra]], [[Indonesia]], increases to 31, with ten others injured, and dozens of others missing. [https://www.dw.com/en/indonesia-floods-landslides-kill-31-in-north-sumatra/a-70915310 (DW)]
*Six people are killed and eight others are injured after a [[launching gantry]] and [[precast concrete]] segments collapsed onto the [[Rama II Road]] at a construction site of the {{ill|Motorway 82 (Thailand)|lt=Ekkachai–Ban Phaeo Intercity Motorway|th|ทางหลวงพิเศษหมายเลข 82}} in [[Samut Sakhon province|Samut Sakhon]], [[Thailand]]. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2911011/fatal-crane-collapse-on-rama-ii-road (''Bangkok Post'')]

'''Politics and elections''' 
*[[2024 Irish general election]]
**Citizens of [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] vote in a [[snap election]] to elect the 174 members of the [[34th Dáil|34th]] [[Dáil Éireann]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/ireland-votes-in-snap-general-election/a-70914602 (DW)]
*The [[United Kingdom]] [[House of Commons of the United Kingdom|House of Commons]] votes 330–275 to pass the [[second reading]] of the [[Terminally Ill Adults (End of Life) Bill|Terminally Ill Adults Bill]], marking the first time the [[Parliament of the United Kingdom|Parliament]] has voted in favour of [[assisted suicide in the United Kingdom|assisted dying]]. The bill will now need to pass several more stages before becoming law. [https://www.theguardian.com/society/2024/nov/29/mps-vote-for-assisted-dying-in-england-and-wales (''The Guardian'')]
